accounting_scope: Application-layer rekey TX payload bytes attempted by the protocol. Bootstrap registration, report messages, MAC headers, routing control traffic, retransmissions, and radio-energy costs are excluded.
adaptive_initial_policy: initial-k dissemination followed by adaptive parity
guardrails: These are application-level payload-byte costs, not radio energy measurements.
A lower byte count is not interpreted independently of reconstruction and completion.
Static uses the same 3-of-5 baseline as the 6F.1 three-protocol comparison.
Paired results use identical simulation-seed identifiers but do not imply identical packet-level loss realizations across protocols.
